campaign: gated EKF baro vertical-velocity aid, 4-altitude 20 s outage A/B
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
gating: g_baro_vel_aid_enable && g_mode_degraded_gnss && outage age >8 s && altitude >1 m
scenario: 10/20/30/40 m settled, 20 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds, aid off/on same binary
verdict: Strong tail reduction at 20-40 m: touchdown p95 3.21/1.02/1.19 -> 1.03/0.99/0.95 m/s, max 3.58/3.29/6.94 -> 1.11/1.09/1.18 m/s; drift median at 30/40 m 530/401 -> 190/177 m; roll max at 40 m 50.4 -> 39.9 deg. At 10 m the aid slightly worsens touchdown median 0.96 -> 1.41 m/s (still max 1.82) with no drift benefit; recommend enabling only for >=20 m / long descents, not at 10 m.
caveats: The 10 m aid-on arm activates for a shorter time (attempts 2511 vs 3600) and is not beneficial; a min-altitude gate is a possible future refinement but not yet implemented.
20 m aid-on drift p95/max is slightly worse (575/939 vs 548/651 m) despite better touchdown; it is a tail trade.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
